howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: Drop a JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, or GIF — up to 50 MB.

howto.name: Set the color count
howto.text: Drag the slider from 2 to 24 colors. 6 is a good default for most brand/UI work.

howto.name: Copy any color
howto.text: The dominant colors appear as swatches with HEX, RGB, and coverage percentage. Click a color to copy its HEX code, or copy them all at once.

faq.a: We shrink the image to fit within 400×400 for speed, then run a fast octree quantization to find the N most-dominant colors. Percentages are based on pixel coverage.

faq.q: Will it find the brand color from a logo?
faq.a: Usually yes — logos have a few dominant colors that octree picks up well. For logos on white backgrounds, asking for 6 colors typically gives 1 white + the actual brand colors.

faq.q: Can I get more than 24 colors?
faq.a: Not in this tool — beyond 24 the palette becomes too noisy to be useful. For full palette analysis, export the image to a design tool.
